mode: Native PostgreSQL standalone VALUES under UTF-8, standard-conforming strings and builtin type resolution.

ValuesQuery.role: A complete unordered native constant table with typed column positions.
ValuesQuery.structure: A nonempty ordered list of rows of equal width and a native release. Each column kind follows from all corresponding cells.
ValuesQuery.conditions: Require a nonempty rectangular list of checked cells, at most 1664 fields per row and a compatible native type at each position.
ValuesQuery.meaning: Return the bag of all supplied rows. Names are column1 through columnN. The native kind of each column is resolved across its entire vertical input.
ValuesQuery.sql: Emit VALUES with every row and cell in structural order. Print each explicitly typed operand in its native role.

ValuesRow.role: One ordered row of scalar constants in a standalone VALUES.
ValuesRow.structure: An owned ordered nonempty list of checked ValuesCell operands.
ValuesRow.conditions: Admit only the specified immutable cell objects. A builtin cast cell must contain a literal NULL. The owning query checks common types and width across rows.
ValuesRow.meaning: Supply one cell per column position; retain duplicate rows and explicit source kind.
ValuesRow.sql: Parenthesize the cell list and render each literal or its qualified builtin NULL cast.

ValuesCell.role: A scalar operand of one standalone VALUES cell.
ValuesCell.structure: Exactly one immutable signed int4, signed int8, Boolean literal, typed text, untyped literal NULL or builtin cast of literal NULL.
ValuesCell.conditions: A builtin cast cell must contain a literal NULL. Validate the closed operand choice before sharing the cell with a row.
ValuesCell.meaning: Supply the exact literal value and its native kind, or an untyped absence that adopts the complete column kind.
ValuesCell.sql: Emit the literal with its necessary native type qualification. Keep an explicit NULL cast and a genuinely untyped NULL distinct.

structure: The matrix retains a closed typed value in each position. The resolved output heading is uniquely derived from the ordered dimensions and per-column cells.
conditions: Accept integer and bigint mixtures, Boolean columns, text columns and untyped NULL in each compatible column. Untyped quoted strings are accepted where the selected output is text. An all-untyped NULL column resolves to text. Reject incompatible types, non-rectangular or empty shapes, contextual DEFAULT and analysis inputs without a checked cell.
meaning: Every row contributes one result without deduplication or an ordering requirement. Resolve unknown NULLs against all typed neighbors in their column. Native int4 values widen into a bigint column without value loss. Preserve every explicitly typed NULL's type participation.
sql: Emit a single native VALUES operation with matching row boundaries and exact literals. Use qualified PostgreSQL builtin types where needed to guarantee signed width, text identity or typed NULL.
observations: Structural row and position coordinates, cell kind and exact value
Result names and positions, PostgreSQL type OIDs, duplicate and NULL rows including matching all-null columns
Native int4 and bigint boundary values and exact UTF-8 text, apostrophes and backslashes
Whole-column type resolution after two or more leading untyped NULL rows

finite.completeness: Recover dimensions, primary output kind and placement from checked cells. Use typed NULL in the one-row null-first representative to distinguish it from other layouts.

analysis: Integer and bigint at the signed boundaries
Boolean and text in separate columns and duplicate rows
Two leading untyped NULL values before a signed result
A column containing only untyped NULL values
Typed Boolean and bigint NULL in separate columns
Untyped UTF-8 text and explicitly typed text
Repeated multi-column rows with untyped NULL beside nonnull text
negative: Boolean mixed with typed integer in one column
Text mixed with typed Boolean in one column
Unchecked cast operand in a cell
Row wider than the native 1664-column result limit

exploration.requiredForms: Vary dimensions, positional roles, signed extremes, exact text values, native kind, typed and untyped NULL and row duplication.

evidence.P01: Preserve cell kind, ordered positions and the uniquely derived common type and heading.
evidence.P02: Validate closed cell roles and whole-matrix invariants before publication.
evidence.P03: Use only typed values, row positions and the database profile.
evidence.P04: Derive output by positional whole-column type resolution and bag union of rows.
evidence.P05: Own detached rectangular rows and closed immutable cell operands.
evidence.P06: Print each supported matrix with native positional names, inferred type, values and duplicates.
evidence.Q01: Check malformed shapes, incompatible columns and unchecked operands against their owning boundary.
evidence.Q02: Construct the complete fixed Cartesian grid and all required analyzed forms.
evidence.Q03: Compare a positional type and row oracle with the loaded graph and actual fixtures.
evidence.Q04: Compare result OIDs, names and typed rows in native PostgreSQL.
evidence.Q05: Observe the exact public construction and analysis routes from both Composer layouts.

open: FROM and WITH composition, set arms and ORDER BY or row bounds at the VALUES query boundary
Nonconstant expressions, native parameters and implicit conversion of bare strings to non-text column types
Additional native types, domains and collation selection
trust: Native pinned PostgreSQL literal behavior and column-name rules
Independent oracle and typed PDO adapter
Protected source, runtime and package identity

positiveBoundaries.rule: Check the last native heading and every typed output slot at the native field limit.
